steps.caption: FiveTech Desktop & Web — the same ERP screens run inside Windows (WebView2) and in any browser. One HTML UI, one HTTP API, one meta model.
Everything you see is driven by JSON under meta/: screens, menus, data, reports and even this tour. Change JSON → restart or Save → UI updates. No recompile for structure.

steps.label: Appointments
steps.caption: The left sidebar comes from modules.json (or your vertical pack). Click any item to open a meta screen. Home today: Appointments.

steps.label: Parties
steps.caption: CRM core starts with Parties: people and companies in one list. Roles (Patient, Customer, Lead…), source and owner — generic for any industry.

steps.label: Party card
steps.caption: Layout form = tabbed card. Same party data as the list, different presentation. Design form (admin) can edit tabs, fields and control types at runtime.

steps.label: Activities
steps.caption: Activities track calls, tasks, meetings and notes linked to a party. Grid columns use select / checklist / checkbox controls from meta.

steps.label: Opportunities
steps.caption: Opportunities hold pipeline amounts, probability and close date. Money fields respect app.locale (currency, decimals, separators).

steps.label: Pipeline board
steps.caption: Layout workflow: same opportunities, shown as a stage board with allowed transitions (Lead → Qualified → …). Great for sales process demos.
Verticals (clinic / services / retail) only reshuffle the menu and labels. Core CRM and datasets stay shared. Switch pack in Edit app → Vertical — applies immediately.

captionByVertical.clinic: Clinic pack: Patients master — clinic language on top of party codes. Lists are still meta grids with search, toolbar and CRUD.
captionByVertical.services: Services pack: Projects — budget, spent, status and type. Delivery work sits next to CRM clients.
captionByVertical.retail: Retail pack: Products — SKU, barcode, tax and price. Store catalog ready for POS.

captionByVertical.clinic: Layout wizard: Admission — multi-step capture. Other layouts in the pack: form cards, calendars, invoices…
captionByVertical.services: Timesheets: hours × rate, billable flag, approval status — classic professional-services loop.
captionByVertical.retail: POS tickets: register, cashier, tender and status — day sales without a full POS hardware stack.

captionByVertical.clinic: Layout master-detail: Invoices — header grid + linked lines. Toolbar: add/edit/delete, print, PDF, Excel.
captionByVertical.services: Layout document: Quotes with line totals and default VAT from app.locale.taxRate. Recalc updates subtotal / tax / total.
captionByVertical.retail: Stock by warehouse: qty, min, reserved, bin and status — inventory sketch for the store.

steps.label: Day agenda
steps.caption: Layout calendar: Day agenda slots by room/resource. Same idea as appointments, different meta layout engine.

steps.label: Dashboard
steps.caption: Layout dashboard: KPI tiles from data.dashboard_kpis. Useful landing page for managers — still just meta + data JSON.

steps.label: Reports
steps.caption: report.* definitions: columns + dataRef + optional groupBy/sumFields. Preview, PDF or CSV. From any list, admin can Save as report. Not a band designer — by design.
Admin only — Design form: change layout, columns, select/checklist options, master-detail and workflow transitions. Save writes meta JSON live.
Admin only — Edit app: branding, HTTP port, vertical pack, locale (currency/decimals/VAT) and the full sidebar menu. Menu saves into the active vertical pack.
Locale settings format every money cell and document tax. Try EUR with comma decimals vs USD with point — Save app and watch grids refresh.

steps.label: Parties
steps.caption: Tour finished. Explore freely. Tips: demo/demo auto-starts this tour · admin/1234 unlocks designers · ▶ Demo replays anytime · Escape stops the tour.
